name: gizza-ai/data-uri-decode
summary: Decode a data: URI into its MIME type and payload

tool.description: Parse and decode a data: URI (RFC 2397) of the form data:[<mediatype>][;base64],<data>. Returns the MIME type (defaulting to text/plain when omitted), any media-type parameters such as charset, whether the payload was Base64 or percent-encoded, the decoded byte length, and the payload itself. A payload that decodes to printable UTF-8 is returned as text; a binary payload is reported with its detected file type (from magic bytes, e.g. image/png) and a hex preview. Tolerates whitespace/newlines inside Base64. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

uri.description: The data: URI to decode, e.g. 'data:text/plain;base64,SGVsbG8='.
